title: az devops team list-member --team ${team} --project ${project} --top 101 --output json
description: A team's members, the first 101, so a 101st says there are more than the 100 kit draws, which kit draws as the teams stage's members and, across the teams, the people stage's in `modules/bash/forge/ado.sh` (forge/ado:teams-read, with `modules/jq/forge.jq` forge::ado_teams and forge::ado_collaborators); every call kit makes through forge/ado:az also carries --org ${organization} --detect false --only-show-errors. The extension reads TeamMember and IdentityRef, https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/azure/devops/core/teams/get-team-members-with-extended-properties?view=azure-devops-rest-7.1.

isContainer.description: True for a group the team holds; absent for a person.
